sections.headline: Stay at Essência.
sections.content:
_However long you stay, there's a way to rest here that suits you._

From the communal warmth of the farmhouse to a quiet pitch under your own canvas — every space on the land is built to bring you closer to the rhythm of the community, and to yourself.

sections.headline: The Farmhouse
sections.content:
_Come back to yourself, nestled in nature._

Six lovingly designed rooms, each with a private bathroom, floor-to-ceiling windows and a terrace with a view worth waking up for. Guests share an open kitchen and a cosy living room with fireplace, plus a guest WC — heated by solar-thermal and the fire, and powered by 18 solar panels with battery storage and a backup generator. High-speed Wi-Fi throughout, via Starlink.

- 6 rooms, each with a private bathroom
- Solar-thermal heating & fireplace
- 18 solar panels + battery, with backup generator
- High-speed Wi-Fi via Starlink

sections.headline: The Yurts
sections.content:
_Reconnect with yourself, surrounded by forest and birdsong._

Two to three single yurts and one double yurt, hand-built and tucked into the trees. Singles have a double bed and their own deck — pure nature, some with a fireplace or freestanding gas heater and an outdoor kitchen. The double yurt sleeps more, with two double beds, a couch, a kitchen, fireplace and pellet heating, plus Starlink internet. All yurts share access to a co-working space with the community, also on Starlink.

- 2–3 single yurts, plus 1 double yurt
- Cold water; some with hot water & outdoor shower
- Outdoor compost toilet; some with fireplace or gas heater
- Shared co-working space with Starlink internet

sections.headline: Glamping Tents
sections.content:
_Your temple in the forest, with the birds._

Three 4-season tents, insulated and fitted with diesel heating for winter comfort — our other glamping tents run seasonally, available April through October. Every tent has a kingsize bed with a feather duvet and a carpeted floor. Guests share an outdoor kitchen, showers, toilets and a co-working space with the community, all on Starlink internet.

- 3 four-season tents with diesel heating (winter)
- Other tents available April – October
- Kingsize bed, feather duvet & carpet
- Shared kitchen, showers, WCs & co-working, Starlink

sections.headline: Camper Vans & Vans
sections.content:
_Wake up surrounded by nature, birdsong, and wide open skies._

A peaceful place to slow down, recharge, and enjoy the simple beauty of countryside living — whether you stay a few nights or longer. We keep a small number of carefully placed spots to keep the atmosphere calm and spacious. Guests share access to the outdoor kitchen, showers, toilets and a co-working space with the community, all on Starlink internet.

- A few carefully placed spots, kept calm & spacious
- Shared kitchen, showers, WCs & co-working, Starlink
